intro: ITrackZen by LibDex Ltd welcomes cooperation with businesses that can bring tracking solutions to customers in their markets, install and support hardware, or integrate with our platform.

types.title: Resellers & distributors
types.text: Offer ITrackZen subscriptions and compatible hardware to your customers in your territory.

types.title: Installation partners
types.text: Vehicle electronics, auto-electrical and security companies that can install and service trackers, sensors and dashcams.

types.title: Technology & hardware partners
types.text: Tracker, sensor and camera manufacturers or integrators who want to confirm compatibility.

types.title: Corporate & fleet cooperation
types.text: Logistics, transport, mining, NGO and government fleets interested in pilots or framework agreements.

process.title: Tell us about your business
process.text: Use the partnership form: your company, countries, customers and the cooperation you have in mind.

process.title: We review and respond
process.text: Our team reviews fit and coverage and contacts you to discuss next steps.

process.title: Agree terms
process.text: If we proceed, we agree scope, responsibilities and commercial terms in writing before any activity starts.

note: We do not currently list approved partners or local offices on this website. Partner details will be published only once agreements are confirmed.
